here = os.path.abspath(os.path.dirname(__file__))
topsrcdir = os.path.abspath(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(here)))
topcommdir = os.path.join(topsrcdir, "comm")
DOC_ROOT = os.path.join(topcommdir, "docs")

with open(os.path.join(DOC_ROOT, "config.yml"), "r") as fh:
        docs_config = yaml.safe_load(fh)

text: The historical 943 Mach command sets DOC_ROOT to topsrcdir/docs even though it adds the policy file at comm/docs/config.yml. The accepted command sets DOC_ROOT to topcommdir/docs and reads that file after Sphinx. Preserve the current root distinction in command helpers. This is exact historical/current source reconciliation; no original build failure was reproduced and the later root repair was not fully reviewed.
title: Keep the documentation root inside Comm when reading its policy file
